You said:

Can you make it bigger, maybe twice the size it currently is

LOGO said:

Python
from PIL import Image

# Load source image used for icon
img = Image.open('/mnt/data/a_digital_icon_features_a_square_with_rounded_corn.png').convert("RGBA")

# Make artwork appear ~2x larger inside same square by scaling up and cropping
w,h = img.size
scaled = img.resize((int(w*2), int(h*2)), Image.LANCZOS)

# center-crop back to original canvas size
left = (scaled.width - w)//2
top = (scaled.height - h)//2
cropped = scaled.crop((left, top, left+w, top+h))

# save preview PNG + ICO
png_out='/mnt/data/PTV_GeoClean_CleanSquare_2x.png'
ico_out='/mnt/data/PTV_GeoClean_CleanSquare_2x.ico'
cropped.save(png_out)
cropped.save(ico_out, format='ICO', sizes=[(32,32),(48,48),(64,64),(128,128),(256,256)])

print(ico_out)
STDOUT/STDERR
/mnt/data/PTV_GeoClean_CleanSquare_2x.ico

Done — I made the icon approximately 2× larger visually inside the square frame so it should read much better in:

  • Windows desktop shortcuts

  • Taskbar / Start menu

  • PTV application launcher / toolbar icons

  • Small UI sizes (16–48 px)
